title: MPK / Mirage Persistent Kernel: Compiling LLMs into a MegaKernel
summary_en: MPK is a compiler and runtime (CMU; Zhihao Jia / Tianqi Chen) that auto-transpiles a whole LLM decode step's task graph into ONE persistent megakernel, eliminating every inter-kernel HBM round-trip and per-kernel launch/dispatch overhead, for 1.2x-6.7x lower decode latency (single-GPU ~1.0-1.7x). It is the maximal inter-kernel-fusion system: if transient activation / L2 reuse across kernels mattered, MPK would cash it in here. Yet the paper attributes its single-GPU gain to launch elimination plus intra-kernel pipelining, and bounds latency by the WEIGHT roofline (~10 ms = 16 GB / 1.6 TB/s on A100) -- never to activation/L2 reuse. We reproduce the demo (Qwen3-8B, A100-80GB, baseline vs --use-mirage) and use direct Nsight Compute attribution to bound the inter-kernel L2-activation-reuse share of step time below 0.65%, supporting our "Worth the Bytes?" measurement study.
summary_zh: MPK 是 CMU（Zhihao Jia / Tianqi Chen）的編譯器加執行期系統，將整個 LLM decode step 的 task graph 自動轉譯成「單一」persistent megakernel，消除所有 inter-kernel HBM 往返與每個 kernel 的 launch/dispatch 開銷，使 decode 延遲降低 1.2x-6.7x（單 GPU 約 1.0-1.7x）。它是 inter-kernel fusion 的極大化系統：若跨 kernel 的暫態 activation / L2 重用真的重要，MPK 正是會把它兌現的地方。然而論文把單 GPU 的增益歸因於 launch 消除加上 kernel 內 pipelining，並以「權重」roofline（A100 上約 10 ms = 16 GB / 1.6 TB/s）作為延遲下界，從未訴諸 activation/L2 重用。我們重現 demo（Qwen3-8B、A100-80GB、baseline vs --use-mirage），並用直接的 Nsight Compute 歸因，將 inter-kernel L2-activation-reuse 佔 step time 的比例上界壓到 0.65% 以下，支持我們「Worth the Bytes?」量測研究。
